scope: Exact-value comparison against existing private local runtime environment credentials and password/token fields in the explicit private fixture files, including expired/reused recovery and expired/normal SSR cookie fixtures, selected local JWT/JWKS material, owned auth-valid-recovery UUID password-restoration checkpoints and private JWK scalar fields (d/k/p/q/dp/dq/qi). Values, hashes of values and matching excerpts are never published. Includes tracked and non-ignored untracked repository files, not ignored build assets or external files; no claim of universal absence of secrets.
